role: Non-destructive links from exact existing saint strings into source owner records. Not a list of certified saints, biographies or liturgical day rulings.

match_policy.normalization: diacritics + explicit honorific prefix + punctuation only
match_policy.ambiguity: Manual alias-equivalent candidate lookup, never short substring matching. All cross-source matches are editorial candidates; approval requires owner-source confirmation.
match_policy.artwork: Research artwork does not imply approved master, iconographical match or reproduction permission.
match_policy.relics: Relic subject record does not authenticate a relic or certify canonical saint status.
match_policy.novenas: Only direct devotional addressees manually joined; not feast/devotion analogies.
match_policy.calendar: Semantic keys are thematic/calendar bridge records. Neither saint's actual 1962 feast date, commemoration nor optional current-calendar observation is inferred.
match_policy.shrine: Exact old source place IDs only; no evidence the saint lived or died there.
